meta.title: Download Legal Masr
meta.subtitle: Free downloads for Windows 10/11 x64 and Linux x64. macOS and mobile are not included.

actions.mobile: Legal Masr is a desktop app. Open this page on your computer to download it.

windows.title: Windows
windows.note: Windows may show a SmartScreen or unknown-publisher warning because this beta is unsigned.

linux.title: Linux
linux.desc: x64 packages for Debian/Ubuntu and Fedora-compatible systems, plus AppImage. Compatibility depends on your distribution.
linux.note: After downloading, open a terminal in the folder that contains the file and run the command shown on the card.

windows-installer.name: Windows installer (.exe)
windows-installer.desc: The recommended option. Installs the app and adds a Start menu shortcut.

windows-portable.name: Portable version (.zip)
windows-portable.desc: Extract the ZIP before launching. App data stays in the normal operating-system data folder; it does not travel with the ZIP.

linux-deb.name: Debian / Ubuntu (.deb)
linux-deb.desc: For Debian, Ubuntu, Linux Mint and similar distributions.

linux-rpm.name: Fedora-compatible package (.rpm)
linux-rpm.desc: RPM package for compatible x64 systems.

linux-appimage.name: AppImage (.AppImage)
linux-appimage.desc: Make the file executable before launching. Compatibility depends on system libraries; app data stays in the normal operating-system data folder.
